name: WF2i TikTok Export Ingestion (Drive Auto to Raw Sheets)

nodes.name: Weekly Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every Monday 09:00 and ingests the latest TikTok export file for the previous complete week.

nodes.name: Monthly Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs on the first day of the month. It ingests the latest TikTok export file it finds for each brand.

nodes.name: Filter brands ready for TikTok export ingestion
Find Latest TikTok Export in Drive
nodes.notes: Searches Drive automatically. To limit search, add TikTok_Export_Folder_ID or TikTok_Drive_Folder_ID to the Brand Registry row.

nodes.name: Download export file
nodes.notes: If the file is a native Google Sheet, set Google File Conversion to XLSX in this node if your n8n UI asks for it.

nodes.name: Extract TikTok XLSX/CSV
nodes.notes: Parses the downloaded TikTok export. If your exports are CSV, change Operation to Extract From CSV.
